item.text:
Refactored the codebase again to simplify the design rather than just adding more types.

The main change is that graph construction now lives with the graph model itself in [Graph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/Graph.java:5). That let me remove `GraphInputParser.java`, eliminate the coupling where `Edge` depended on parser constants, and centralize graph-level validation and connectivity checks in one place. The entry point in [kruskals_mst.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/kruskals_mst.java:1) is now a thin wrapper over `Graph.fromRawEdges(...)` and `KruskalSolver`.

I also tightened the algorithm implementation in [KruskalSolver.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/KruskalSolver.java:1) by introducing a small internal `MstState` accumulator. That keeps mutation local to the solver and makes the control flow easier to follow. `Edge` is now self-contained as well, with its own raw-edge shape constant in [Edge.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/Edge.java:1).
